data.one_liner: Toolkit for tooltips, persistent hints, and spotlight guided tours in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an overlay engine, placement resolver, and theme to render tooltips, persistent hints, beacons, and multi-step guided tours with spotlight effects. It supports disabled widgets, route-spanning tours, and accessibility features with zero runtime dependencies.
use_when: You need to build user onboarding flows or guided tours spanning multiple routes.
You want to display tooltips or hints attached to disabled widgets.
You require customizable tooltips and spotlight effects with zero external dependencies.
avoid_when: You only need simple, out-of-the-box Material tooltips without custom styling or tours.
strengths: Supports route-spanning guided tours and disabled widgets
Comprehensive feature set including accessibility, analytics, and persistence
weaknesses: Requires proper Overlay and scope setup for tours
Default storage does not persist between app launches
data.setup_notes: No native setup required. Pure Flutter with zero runtime dependencies.
